_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 24: July 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says September will be the month to remember and that a great change will start to take place, tied to Rosh Hashanah which he struggles to pronounce.
mentions.quote: September will be the month to remember
mentions.falsify_match: A great change beginning in September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says the generals are getting ready to go home while new Davids rise up with slingshots to take down giants and Esthers stand before the king, and asks whether the viewer will be one of them.
mentions.quote: as we see these generals get ready to go home
mentions.falsify_match: A generational handover among prominent ministers.

mentions.claim_text: He says backing a bear into a corner is serious enough that the thing is about to kick off, and calls prayer for a de-escalation of war in Europe and against a retaliation in Cuba directed at America.
mentions.quote: pray where if it was to escalate to that for a retaliation in Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation in Europe and a Russian retaliation staged from Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He promotes an autumn assembly of prayer in October, calling it a life changing prayer session and the people good people who love the Lord.
mentions.quote: her prayer autumn assembly of prayer that is coming up in October
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event promotion.

mentions.claim_text: He recommends the trip for the autumn leaves, saying the Ozark Mountains in October are beautiful and usually starting to peak.
mentions.quote: the Ozark Mountains during uh October are absolutely beautiful
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: travel note.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a six day tent meeting on the campground and says that last year the glory cloud came in so thick that his wife saw it and people were being healed by the power in it.
mentions.quote: glory cloud came in there and it was so thick that people were getting healed
mentions.falsify_match: Verified healings at that meeting, which would have witnesses.

mentions.claim_text: He tells viewers these meetings matter to him and points them to two ministries' websites and itineraries, including a healing school.
mentions.quote: these are very important meetings to me that are coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: event promotion.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after he gave the word about the UFO thing people started telling him Harvard has said something is coming by November that is an alien ship.
mentions.quote: Harvard said something's going to come by November that's an alien ship
mentions.falsify_match: The 3I/ATLAS interstellar object approach, which is real; the alien ship reading is not Harvard's institutional position.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim; viewer corroboration he repeats.

mentions.claim_text: He says there are certain things they can stop and certain things they cannot, and that the ones that cannot be stopped because they are going to happen do not have to affect you, since they are in the world but not of it.
mentions.quote: certain things we can stop and there's certain things we can't
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it completes the licence: unstopped events were unstoppable, and they need not touch the believer anyway.

mentions.claim_text: He rests on Psalm 23, that he will fear no evil, the rod and staff comfort him and a table is prepared in the presence of enemies, and says God told him he would take care of him.
mentions.quote: He prepares a table before me in the presence of all my enemies
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: scripture applied as assurance.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying it is time to get excited, that he has looked for this moment longer than they have and has longed for it, describing something always dreamed of but never seen.
mentions.quote: It's time to get excited. I've looked for this moment longer than what you have
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion.

mentions.claim_text: He describes wanting to get a big minivan and travel in October and November to see what they can see.
mentions.quote: we can in October and in November anytime we to travel
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: travel plans.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was important to the Lord to talk about going into October, when supernatural windows and doors will open for people who have been believing and standing for things a long time.
mentions.quote: going into October. Supernatural windows will open
mentions.condition_text: for those who have kept believing and standing
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable at corpus level: private breakthroughs over an unnamed audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says everything he has warned about 2027 stands and that he sees a plague, mentioning rats running around the ground in what he was shown.
mentions.quote: Everything I've warned you all about about 2027 and I see a plague
mentions.falsify_match: A plague in 2027, with rodents as a vector, which fits the bubonic framing.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls the Lord telling him you can ride the wave, that it is transitional and will not last forever, and frames a question about where to invest.
mentions.quote: ride the wave. If you go back to the last video, ride the wave
mentions.falsify_match: A market run that ends inside the window he gives.
mentions.falsify_miss: The run continues past it, or never starts.

mentions.claim_text: He says the sky is not falling and tells Chicken Little so, but that Jesus is coming back for a glorious church, and asks whether the viewer is ready.
mentions.quote: The sky is not falling, Chicken Little
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and notable for tone: he pushes back on his own audience's catastrophism.

mentions.claim_text: He says that with the settlements the hose will become unkinked, there will be a waterfall coming in the fall, and that September will be a time to remember with great change coming.
mentions.quote: the hose will become uncinkedked and there will be a waterfall coming in the fall
mentions.falsify_match: Legal settlements releasing a sharp rise in the autumn of 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says that from that time on it becomes the standard, as it was back at forty cents, and that it does not go far back down, maybe four, five, ten or even thirty cents but nothing near where it was, and it goes for miles.
mentions.quote: like it was back at 40 cents and this becomes a standard
mentions.falsify_match: The asset establishing a durable price floor far above its old level.
mentions.falsify_miss: It falls back to previous levels.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him it is time to ride the wave because it will not last very long and then it is over, that he saw it going into 2026, and that this is the window being given.
mentions.quote: It's time to ride the wave for it will not last very long
mentions.falsify_match: A market run through into 2026 that then ends.
mentions.falsify_miss: No run, or one that does not end.

mentions.claim_text: In spontaneous prayer he says he is parked around 31 October, sees darkness in that week, and sees baseball.
mentions.quote: I'm parked around October 31st and I see in this darkness
mentions.falsify_match: A dark event in the week of 31 October 2025 connected to baseball, which is World Series week.

mentions.claim_text: He says the very atmosphere and the urgency of the atmosphere are changing, that he is in October, and that he sees a dark cloud over something.
mentions.quote: I'm in October. There's an urgency in the atmosphere that's changing
mentions.falsify_match: A marked change in October 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says things will increase, that it is highlighted from Rosh Hashanah to Rosh Hashanah with the birthing pains, and that going into October he sees baseball again.
mentions.quote: It's highlighted around from Rasha Shana to Rashishana
mentions.falsify_match: An event around baseball in October 2025, the World Series month.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note the same baseball image preceded the 2024 Yankees word.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all circling around September and that he sees September as a time to remember.
mentions.quote: It's all circling around September. I see September a time to remember
mentions.falsify_match: September 2025 proving memorable.

mentions.claim_text: He wonders whether their prayers and the run of tremors around the ring of fire at magnitude six and seven are relieving pressure on the volcano he saw just outside Oregon's coastline.
mentions.quote: is that relieving pressure on that volcano that I saw right outside Oregon's coastline
mentions.falsify_match: A submarine eruption or major quake off the Oregon coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and he offers the tremors themselves as evidence the prayer is working.

mentions.claim_text: He says September is circled along with the summer months, that he has warned repeatedly to keep continual prayer going over churches, government and leaders, and that he saw attacks still trying to come against the president.
mentions.quote: September. He circled these summer months
mentions.falsify_match: A further attempt on the president in that window.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he says he is looking into the month of November.
mentions.quote: I see November. I'm looking into the month of November
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as given: no content attached yet.

mentions.claim_text: Describing November he says it may not make much sense but he sees ground that looks like corn kernels on a corn cob.
mentions.quote: I see a ground that looks like corn. C corn kernels on a corn cob
mentions.falsify_match: Something involving corn or the corn harvest in November 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing, and he says himself it may not make sense.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a figure clicking his heels in the air with legs made of straw, jumping like the scarecrow from the Wizard of Oz, off to the side of the corn.
mentions.quote: I see his legs with straw, jumping like the scarecrow on the Wizard of Oz
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an uninterpreted image, and he offers no reading of it.
